source.version: Part 16 — Diseases, Viroids, and Microbial Ecology — Batch 03
source.publicationAuthorization: Project owner authorized continued website publication on 2026-09-01. Independent specialist approval remains a separate project-control field and is not implied by publication.
source.releaseTimeReview: THC-ENC-311–315 were reconciled against 2026 multi-state BCTV strain/vector/seed research; current Cannabis/hemp virome and molecular-diagnostic literature; 2024–2026 HLVd tissue-distribution, asymptomatic-infection, and test-timing studies; and current university diagnostic-sampling guidance. Public wording separates vector presence from infection, virus-like phenotype from causal virus identity, visual health from pathogen status, and a negative specimen from absolute clearance.
source.note: This batch extends controlled Volume 16 with Beet curly top virus, other virus/viroid-like syndromes, latent infection, laboratory sampling, and false-negative/composite-sample/test-timing interpretation.
